reviews.text: Simply put: she saved my cat! I've rarely experienced such excellent care. Both vets are passionate. The assistants are too, and incredibly professional. I highly recommend them!

No negative points to say. Exceptional staff and vets . We have a large dog with epilepsy who gets very very stressed at every vet visit . The staff are all extremely patient and kind and have gone above and beyond every time to make sure our dog is happy and healthy . Recently we needed to come last minute as our dog had a problem with his ear , they saw us right away and managed to remove what was in his ear, give him his vaccines and take a blood sample all in less than 45mins . Thank you to all the staff for their help and understanding
Doubts about the competence of one of the veterinarians
Please do not arrange your pet’s international travel paperwork here ☺️
Rude and disdainful doctor, I strongly advise against seeing her.

Hello,

I wanted to share my experience with you.

My first visit to Dr. Bokobza's veterinary clinic for a check-up of my kitten was on January 5, 2026, and the second was yesterday, January 26. I wanted to share my excellent experience with you.

First of all, I noticed that the place was very clean and smelled pleasant.

It really makes me want to come back for more appointments.

And I want to thank Dr. Bokobza for her excellent care and warm welcome.

She is truly very professional, understanding, smiling, and very kind. She takes the time not only to perform all the necessary examinations but also to put the animal at complete trust. Her explanations were clear, and above all, her gentleness during the examination of my kitten was remarkable.

I absolutely do not regret going there, and I never will. She will continue to take care of my kitten throughout her development.

I also wanted to thank the receptionist, who is very kind, attentive, and helpful.

I recommend her 1000%! ✅🥰🌹

The vet was very friendly, understanding, and kind, as was the young woman who worked at the clinic's reception. My cat Camembert was very calm during both of his visits, and the vet was very attentive to him.
I do not recommend this clinic at all.

I went in yesterday because my dog ​​had a problem with his mouth. I was very worried about him, and I remembered this clinic because a couple who have a female dog of the same breed as mine had recommended the vet.

So I called at 9 a.m., explained his problem and my concern, and they gave me an appointment for the same day.

For that alone, I am extremely grateful. Then, registering my dog, although it took some time, I didn't hold it against the young woman at reception because she was taking care of other owners with such passion, and that didn't change for me when my dog ​​was registered.

As for the vet, what can I say? She's a gem, totally dedicated and a true animal lover. My brother and I explained our dog's problem to her.
She examined him carefully and thoughtfully and then told us what to do. Since we need to have him neutered, we also asked her for a quote. I was so surprised to see the price! Elsewhere, they're asking €390 JUST for castration, even though the price is slightly higher at this clinic.

It includes castration, analysis of his problem, and a blood test, given my old boy's age.

For a €45 consultation, it's a 5-star service, from the initial welcome to the consultation itself.

I'm even considering going there exclusively for everything (annual vaccinations, etc.), because since the founder's son took over his previous vet near Vincennes, it seems they're more focused on profit than the well-being of our four-legged companions, not to mention the appalling reception.
Excellent veterinary practice! Dr. Bokobza is very professional and friendly. The receptionist is very attentive and offers great advice. I highly recommend them!

Our vet for Matcha & Alakay for the past year. They are available, welcoming, and take excellent care of our pets.

We highly recommend Ms. Carole and her colleagues.

I'm taking the time to leave a review because this veterinary clinic is, in my opinion, the best in Paris! I don't live nearby, but the professionalism and compassion of everyone who works there are exceptional. Dr. Bokobza is excellent and takes the time not only to perform all the necessary examinations but also to put the animal at ease (and to this extent, it's very rare! My cat lets her handle me like no other vet I've ever seen). She also takes the time to explain things thoroughly. As for the receptionist: wonderful! She too takes the time to give advice and reassure the animal with a kindness and genuine warmth that are truly rare (and of course, this also helps to put the animal at ease). A huge thank you to all the staff at this veterinary clinic (because I'm sure I'm forgetting some) for the excellent care they gave Stella! I recommend them without hesitation.

Dr. Bokobza is a very good veterinarian. She supported one of my cats through the difficult decision of euthanasia during his final days. She was understanding, explained everything to me, and helped me overcome my guilt.

She also cares for my other cat, a 17-year-old senior. She has taught me a great deal about the needs of senior cats. She always gives sound advice, is never judgmental, and always tries to find the best solution at the best price. I am a better cat owner thanks to her.

Thank you.
Always top-notch, thank you to the whole team!
The team is understanding, patient, and reassuring. Our cat has always been very well cared for, and our questions have always been answered. The veterinarian is gentle and explains things patiently.

Thank you to Dr. Bokobza's team for their warm welcome and professionalism. Our cat, Rio, has been a patient at this practice for a year now, and we are very satisfied. Furthermore, the prices are very reasonable. When we brought our cat in for an emergency, Dr. Bokobza didn't charge us for the consultation, unlike some of his colleagues. Thank you for everything!
Very professional.
Always a very warm welcome from Dr. Bokobza or his replacement. The veterinary assistant also gives excellent advice!

A terrible vet, exorbitant prices, and poor knowledge of certain dog breeds; the clinic is far too small for a large, complicated dog! I now go to a clinic on Rue d'Avron; they are attentive and spacious.
A competent and highly professional team. You can have your animals treated there with complete confidence.

The assistant is lovely and gives great advice.
The vet is very kind and gentle with my animals.

In my opinion, this is the best veterinary practice in France 🐈‍⬛ The entire team brings a very special touch to pampering each owner and their pet. They are very attentive to everyone, taking the time to talk, discuss, and explain things precisely and transparently.

Ms. Bokobza is simply wonderful and incredible 🌸❤️ She has been caring for our cat for 8 years with great care 🙏 It was always a pleasure to see her twice a year for check-ups, advice, and treatments.

You can tell that the practice isn't focused on quantity but on quality. They are very flexible in emergencies, and you can book appointments a few days in advance, which was fantastic! They are professionals who love our animal friends above all else 🐱🐰

Thank you so much 😊 Thank you for everything! You and the entire team at the firm are amazing ❤️🐈🐈‍⬛
My beloved cat Ginger was very attentive and gave excellent explanations. A very good vet, thank you!
